rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something usually happens or is generally the case.

example.english: Typically, when it rains, we don't go out.
example.traditional: 通常落雨，我哋就唔出街。
example.jyutping: tung1 soeng4 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for what someone ordinarily does or what happens in their usual day-to-day circumstances.

example.english: I typically go running after work.
example.traditional: 平時我收工之後會去跑步。
example.jyutping: ping4 si4 ngo5 sau1 gung1 zi1 hau6 wui5 heoi3 paau2 bou6

rows.note: Use this when making a broad generalization rather than describing one person's routine.

example.english: Generally speaking, children typically like eating sweets.
example.traditional: 一般嚟講，細路仔都鍾意食糖。
example.jyutping: jat1 bun1 lei4 gong2 sai3 lou6 zai2 dou1 zung1 ji3 sik6 tong4
